<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/uploads/{file}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Requires an `Authorization` header **or** `?token=<media token>`.

A `.heic`/`.heif` path (older uploads, stored before the server
converted images on upload) is answered with a generated JPEG —
`Content-Type: image/jpeg` — since browsers can't decode HEIC. The
path itself is unchanged, and so is the response for every other
format. If the server can't decode the file, the stored bytes are
returned instead.
